title: Unnecessary Default Struct Initializers
pattern: Manually initializing individual fields with their default values instead of utilizing structural default unpacking.
why_bad: Increases boilerplate and maintenance, requiring manual field-by-field definitions instead of relying on the struct's `Default` derivation.
detection: Struct initialization where fields are manually mapped to `Default::default()` or equivalent literals, and the struct implements `Default`.
counterexample: Structuring types that do not implement `Default`.
fix: Use the struct update syntax (`Config { port: 80, ..Default::default() }`).
